verdict.rationale: Treasury Prime is a banking-as-a-service API platform with a developer sandbox and dashboard, so a built-in AI assistant is a plausible capability and the axis applies. The evidence covers only API endpoints, webhooks, sandbox testing and an llms.txt file. The llms.txt only makes the docs readable to outside AI tools and is not an in-product assistant, so nothing shows a built-in assistant that users can delegate tasks to.
